title: The Late Arrival
description:
• Enter a world where the supernatural is natural. In this single-player, first-person, survival, horror game where spirits and people alike have existed together, for better or worse, since the dawn of man. Though, most seem to have forgotten what spirits and creatures lie just beyond the shadows. Their presence only remembered through folklore and stories passed down through the generations. Folklore that Jordan has heard since childhood. Stories they never really believed to be true....until now. Follow Grandpa's instructions, light all the fires, and Jordan just might make it out alive.

Features

-Interactive and immersive gameplay

-Open world

-Horrifying enemies

-Story driven
description_short: In an effort to prove his own sanity, Jordan’s grandfather sends them to the family hunting cabin. Where Jordan would find more truths than they could've ever prepared for.
